title: Admire, do not pity
line: An animal shelter in New Zealand puts a shelter dog at a steering wheel and gear lever
proof: Brought names: adoption interest +590%, all adopted

title: Let the danger speak
line: First-aid charity: a pen lid and a jelly baby complain that babies choke on them
proof: 54 babies whose parents say the film saved them

title: A man, not a plea
line: A water charity: an empty chair in black, the founder sits down and laughs
proof: Sold: 15,000 monthly givers at $30 a month on average

title: Show it finished
line: A well charity: three running wells, three plaques, each with a giver's name
proof: Its owner kept paying: 231 days, 2 copies of the ad

title: One being, one shot
line: An animal rescue: an old dog with a bandaged stump smiles into the lens
